purpose: Minimal integrity contract for independent fresh-context routing probe evidence.

rules.repository_revision: exact 40-character Git SHA of the repository state used to build the isolated context bundle
rules.accessible_context_paths: must be exactly the allowlisted operational paths in routing_fresh_context_stimuli_v1.json
rules.raw_response: must preserve the tested instance response unchanged; JSON is preferred and probe_id must match when present
rules.oracle_policy: Oracle/expected outcome must not be repository-accessible or supplied to the tested instance before raw response persistence. Oracle reveal and grading happen only after capture.
rules.context_file_hashes: must cover exactly the allowlisted operational paths and record the SHA-256 of each file content in the rendered bundle
rules.bundle_identity: SHA-256 identity over probe_identity, repository_revision and ordered context_file_hashes; proves capture/bundle self-consistency, not external repository truth by itself
rules.instance_context: must record provider/product context, model/configuration where known, a session_or_run_id, and a fresh_context_declaration

evidence_claim_boundary: A valid capture record proves internal stimulus/bundle/response integrity and records the declared execution conditions. It does not by itself prove semantic correctness, external repository truth, actual psychological freshness, absence of hidden system-level contamination, or Human effectiveness; independent grading/review remain separate.
